_key.description: Unique identifier for the tested CRISPR element: CRISPR_{chr}_{start}_{end}_GRCh38_{file_accession}

name.description: Display name for the tested CRISPR element (same as _key)

chr.description: Chromosome of the intended CRISPR target element (GRCh38)

start.description: Start coordinate of the intended CRISPR target element (GRCh38)

end.description: End coordinate of the intended CRISPR target element (GRCh38)

promoter_of.description: Ensembl gene whose promoter was the intended CRISPR target when source_annotation is promoter. Absent for enhancer and distal element targets.

method.description: Assay method from the associated files_filesets record

source_annotation.description: Class of the tested genomic element as annotated by the experiment or file config (enhancer, promoter, or distal element)

source_url.description: IGVF portal URL for the source tabular file

type.description: Element type for CRISPR element-gene screens

files_filesets.description: Associated files_filesets record for the source IGVF tabular file
